What this means is that the purchase option would allow us to take accelerated depreciation on the equipment, while the lease option would not. Elena, this could have a material impact on the after-tax cost comparison between the purchase and lease alternatives, and I strongly recommend we incorporate this into the analysis before you make your capital-allocation decision.
